name: Pumpkin
author: lilalexmed@proton.me
description: Pumpkin is a Minecraft server built entirely in Rust, offering a fast, efficient, and customizable experience. It prioritizes performance and player enjoyment while adhering to the core mechanics of the game. By default the installer downloads a prebuilt binary (near-instant install, no compiling). Building from source (needed for forks/custom branches/commits, or if you set Install mode to 'source') still requires around 4GB RAM; adjust docker.installer_limits.memory to a value of 4096 or above and consider increasing docker.installer_limits.cpu for faster builds.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
set -eux

apk add --no-cache musl-dev git wget
mkdir -p /mnt/server

REPO_URL="${GIT_URL:-https://github.com/Pumpkin-MC/Pumpkin.git}"
RELEASE_TAG="${RELEASE_TAG:-nightly}"
INSTALL_MODE="${INSTALL_MODE:-prebuilt}"

USE_PREBUILT=0
if [ "$INSTALL_MODE" = "prebuilt" ] && [ -z "$GIT_URL" ] && [ -z "$GIT_BRANCH" ] && [ -z "$GIT_COMMIT" ]; then
    USE_PREBUILT=1
fi

if [ "$USE_PREBUILT" = "1" ]; then
    ARCH="$(uname -m)"
    case "$ARCH" in
        x86_64)
            ASSET="pumpkin-x86_64-linux-musl"
            if grep -qw avx2 /proc/cpuinfo && grep -qw bmi2 /proc/cpuinfo && grep -qw fma /proc/cpuinfo && grep -qw movbe /proc/cpuinfo && grep -qw f16c /proc/cpuinfo && grep -qw lzcnt /proc/cpuinfo; then
                ASSET="pumpkin-x86_64-v3-linux-musl"
            fi
            ;;
        aarch64)
            ASSET="pumpkin-aarch64-linux-musl"
            ;;
        *)
            echo "Unsupported architecture for prebuilt binaries: $ARCH, falling back to source build"
            USE_PREBUILT=0
            ;;
    esac
fi

if [ "$USE_PREBUILT" = "1" ]; then
    BASE_URL="https://github.com/Pumpkin-MC/Pumpkin/releases/download/${RELEASE_TAG}"
    if wget -q -O "/tmp/${ASSET}" "${BASE_URL}/${ASSET}" && wget -q -O "/tmp/${ASSET}.sha256" "${BASE_URL}/${ASSET}.sha256"; then
        if ( cd /tmp && sha256sum -c "${ASSET}.sha256" ); then
            chmod +x "/tmp/${ASSET}"
            cp "/tmp/${ASSET}" /mnt/server/pumpkin
        else
            echo "Checksum verification failed for prebuilt binary, falling back to source build"
            USE_PREBUILT=0
        fi
    else
        echo "Failed to download prebuilt binary, falling back to source build"
        USE_PREBUILT=0
    fi
fi

if [ "$USE_PREBUILT" != "1" ]; then
    if [ -n "$GIT_BRANCH" ]; then
        git clone --depth 1 --single-branch --branch "$GIT_BRANCH" "$REPO_URL"
    else
        git clone --depth 1 --single-branch "$REPO_URL"
    fi

    cd Pumpkin

    if [ -n "$GIT_COMMIT" ]; then
        git fetch --depth 1 origin "$GIT_COMMIT"
        git checkout "$GIT_COMMIT"
    fi

    git submodule update --init --recursive --depth 1

    if [ -n "$RUST_TARGET_CPU" ]; then
        export RUSTFLAGS="-C target-feature=-crt-static -C target-cpu=${RUST_TARGET_CPU}"
    fi

    if [ "$FAST_BUILD" = "1" ] || [ "$FAST_BUILD" = "true" ]; then
        export CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO=off
        export CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_CODEGEN_UNITS=16
    fi

    export CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=${CARGO_BUILD_JOBS:-default}

    if [[ "$BUILD_RELEASE" == "1" || "$BUILD_RELEASE" == "true" ]]; then
        cargo build --release
        strip target/release/pumpkin
        cp target/release/pumpkin /mnt/server/pumpkin
    else
        cargo build
        cp target/debug/pumpkin /mnt/server/pumpkin
    fi
fi

# Quickly start and kill server to generate config
cd /mnt/server
timeout 1 ./pumpkin

variables.name: Install mode
variables.description:
"prebuilt" -> Download a prebuilt binary matching your CPU (fast, no compiling). Automatically falls back to a source build if no matching asset is found or download fails.
"source" -> Always compile from source (required if you set a Git URL/branch/commit; also happens automatically in that case regardless of this setting).
Scope: installation

variables.name: Release tag
variables.description:
Which GitHub release tag to download the prebuilt binary from. Only used when Install mode is "prebuilt".
Scope: installation

variables.name: Rust target CPU
variables.description:
Optional -C target-cpu value (e.g. "x86-64-v3", "native") used only for source builds, to produce a faster binary tuned for this CPU. Leave empty for a safe, portable baseline build. Warning: "native" (or a mismatched value) can produce a binary that crashes if the server later runs on different hardware than it was built on.
Scope: installation

variables.name: Fast build
variables.description:
Only used for source builds. When enabled, relaxes LTO/codegen-unit settings for this build only (via CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_* overrides) to cut compile time significantly, at a small runtime performance cost. Does not affect prebuilt installs.
Scope: installation

variables.name: Rust backtrace
variables.description:
"0" -> No backtrace is generated. This is the default behavior.
"1" -> Generates a minimal backtrace showing only relevant information about where the panic occurred.
"full" -> Generates a detailed backtrace, showing all frames leading to the panic, including functions in the Rust standard library and dependencies.

variables.name: Build Release
variables.description:
Either build release or a debug build of pumpkin.
Scope: installation

variables.name: Git commit
variables.description:
Chose which git commit to clone.
Scope: installation

variables.name: Git branch
variables.description:
Chose which git branch to clone.
Scope: installation

variables.name: Git URL
variables.description:
Chose which git URL to clone from. Useful if you are using a fork.
Scope: installation

variables.name: Cargo build jobs
variables.description:
Amount of jobs that cargo spawns to compile. Try to reduce them if you encounter a deadlock. Value must be at least 1. To use maximum available threads, use the value 'default'
Scope: installation
